inputs.text: Don't be fooled by this story of an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent who jumped into action after a baby stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line with his family at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. The Department of Homeland Security releasing video footage showing a man holding the baby notice something wrong is a blatant sign of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites. They're pushing this to invert the truth and make these institutions look like saviors when it's all about concealing their real agendas and controlling the public narrative.
